an4.81:1.1: catūhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye
an4.81:1.3: pāṇātipātī hoti adinnādāyī hoti kāmesu micchācārī hoti musāvādī hoti
an4.81:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an4.81:2.1: catūhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge
an4.81:2.3: pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti kāmesu micchācārā paṭivirato hoti musāvādā paṭivirato hoti
an4.81:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ saggeti.
